about: Wrong answers that point to a specific misunderstanding about linear functions. 'pointsTo' is the subskill to work on. Claude's draft (2026-11-21).

misconceptions.description: Mixes up the input and the output: finds f(11) when asked for the x that gives f(x) = 11.
Drops the minus sign of a negative input (f(−2) worked as f(2)).
Gives the input back instead of the output.
Adds one step of the pattern, however far x jumps.
Divides the change in x by the change in y (run over rise).
Subtracts the y's in one order and the x's in the other, so the sign comes out wrong.
Gives the change in y without dividing by the change in x.
Swaps the slope and the y-intercept.
Drops the sign of the slope or the intercept (y = −2x − 7 has slope 2).
Uses where the line crosses the x-axis as b.
Uses a point's y-value as the y-intercept, when that point isn't on the y-axis.
